title: Semantic Observations V1
description: Pixel-space semantic observations from a VLM/SAM/agent looking at posed capture photos. An observation is ONLY 'a labelled pixel box in one frame' - it never carries world coordinates. Grounding into geometry is done by scene-core/semantic_candidates.py via ray casting, and coordinate truth always comes from geometry (point cloud / fit services), never from this payload.

captureFingerprint.description: Identity of the capture the frames belong to (e.g. capture-index indexFingerprint or raw content sha256).

frameId.description: Frame identity as loaded by photo_projection.load_frames: '<transforms-name>#<index>', the frame file_path, or the bare frame index as a string.

bbox.description: Pixel box [x0, y0, x1, y1] in the frame's image, x0 < x1 and y0 < y1, y grows downward.

label.description: Free-form semantic label, e.g. door / window / opening / chair / table / material / poster.

labelConfidence.description: Observer's confidence in the LABEL only. Never a statement about coordinates.

observer.description: Who looked at the image: agent actor id or model name (e.g. 'claude-fable-5', 'sam-2.1').

note.description: Optional free-text context, e.g. 'partially occluded by curtain'.
